top_signals.title: Bitcoin briefly slides below $84,000 as crypto long liquidations reach $487 million
top_signals.summary: Crypto liquidations amounted to $555.6 million over the past 24 hours, including $487.2 million in long positions, according to CoinGlass.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
